name: Samophlange
objectiveText: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet. Samophlange (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
This quest is a bit complex to complete, and even with the information here, it took me a while to figure out.

First, go to the Smokestack at about 53,10.  This is NOT the larger apparatus which is a ways farther to the east, in the Sludge Fen.  The Smokestack is a smaller installation, though it is also surrounded by a lot of guards, workers, peons, etc.  It is just east of the road that leads north from Crossroads.  It is a fair distance up the road, and sits up against a hill, on the south side of the hill.

You will need to kill about 20 guards on this one.  They will probably regenerate before you are done.  If there are any other people nearby, doing the same quest, you really should consider grouping with them.  The grouping won't matter so much on the first tasks, but, unless you group, only ONE person will be able to get the key at the end (fron Tinkerer Sniggles) and you will need to wait for him (and the guards) to regenerate.

Okay, here is the order of tasks:

1.  Kill enough guards to get to the control panel.  It is is in the area in front of the smokestack (next to the smokestack, on the south side), under the canopy.

2.  Go the the control panel, to the left side, under the canopy.  Stand next to it and right click.  After it opens, click, "Complete Task."

3.  Go turn off the 3 valves.  One is on the protrusions from the east side of the smokestack.  One is on the pipe that comes out of the ground behind, on the north side of the smokestack.  One is on the west side of the smokestack, near the base.  The order in which you do this is not important, except that it can only be completed AFTER you have opened the control panel the first time (above).

4.  Go back to the control panel again, and open it again.  This is the second time.  'Complete' that task.

5.  Now, you need to go up the small hill to the east and kill Tinkerer Sniggles.  If you are with a group, you MUST get grouped by this point, or only one of you will get the key.  Tinkerer Sniggles is in the little house, up the hill.  When he dies, you should find a key in his possestions.  Take it.

6.  Final task.  Go back down the hill and open the Control Panel one more time (the 3rd time).  Complete that.  

Now take the Samophlange device to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

I hope this helps make the whole thing clear.
replies: Thank you for the details kostren..I soloed this as a 16 mage. Just follow instructions above.
